app.name: PDFCut
app.tagline: Alle PDF-Werkzeuge, die Sie brauchen. Kostenlos, privat, offline.
common.drop_hint: PDF-Dateien hierher ziehen oder klicken zum Auswählen
home.title: Was möchten Sie tun?
home.empty_recent: No recent files yet. Open a PDF to get started.
home.open_hint: Drop a PDF anywhere to open it
desc.viewer: Read, search, zoom, dark mode, split view and presentation.
desc.split: Cut by page ranges, every N pages, bookmarks, size, blank pages or text.
desc.merge: Combine files, reorder them, pick pages and add bookmarks.
desc.pages: Rotate, delete, reorder, duplicate, crop, N-up and booklet layouts.
desc.compress: Shrink files with quality presets or a target size, with preview.
desc.convert: PDF to images, text, Markdown; images and text to PDF.
desc.ocr: Make scanned pages searchable and extract text from images.
desc.extract: Text, tables to CSV, attachments and document facts.
desc.compare: Side-by-side text diff and visual diff of two PDFs.
desc.annotate: Highlight, draw, sign, add notes and permanently redact.
desc.stamp: Text watermarks, page numbers, headers, footers and Bates numbers.
desc.security: Metadata, safe-share cleaning, passwords, permissions and repair.
desc.batch: Apply operations to many files, and build reusable workflows.
desc.scan: Capture pages from a webcam and turn them into a PDF.
desc.settings: Themes, wallpapers, language, motion, performance and backups.
desc.replace: Replace visible text. Only the edited pages are rasterized, so their original text is removed.
desc.forms: Add text and checkbox fields, fill them, or flatten a form.
desc.automation: Naming rules, duplicate detection, operation history, and retry.
desc.diagnostics: Startup time, memory, render speed, logs and diagnostic reports.
palette.hint: ↑ ↓ to move · Enter to open · Esc to close
